spot.html_text: Different individuals in a population have different morphologies, physiologies, and behaviors (phenotypic variation). Different phenotypes have different rates of survival and reproduction in different environments (differential fitness). There is a correlation between parents and offspring in the contribution of each to future generations (fitness is heritable)
